integration_notes: international_coverage_audit.py is the single canonical public CLI; core, country-code and provenance modules are internal helpers, not alternate runtimes.
The auditor imports existing market, source, shared-family and capability registries; it does not mutate them.
Source/runtime evidence performs no network I/O. PR provenance uses local git history only and reports only explicit pull-request references present in commit messages.
The audit workflow checks out full local git history (fetch-depth 0) so PR provenance can be proven rather than guessed.
Research-only status requires country-specific evidence filename provenance or a regional RESEARCH/GATE document naming the country; broad portfolio/scope documents do not qualify.
ISO3 codes are never matched against prose because valid codes such as ARE can collide with ordinary language.
Path provenance uses contiguous exact slug segments: AUT cannot match auth_* and BASE cannot match database.
Test files are excluded from code/runtime provenance.
TED_EFORMS membership is projected only through the concrete active TED registry source; strategic shared families without a concrete active source are not promoted to executable coverage.
BUILD/SHARED markets without an active production source receive NO_ACTIVE_PRODUCTION_SOURCE and a matching missing-integration entry.
The dedicated workflow generates deterministic JSON and Markdown artifacts and validates country, contradiction, missing-integration, research, capability and PR-provenance contracts.
No country/source state, runtime registry, production deployment, or Master Queue item is modified.
